Are you ready for a logistics role with real responsibility? 🚀 Where you don't just work on the floor, but also handle system administration on the PC and mentor new colleagues? Become a Senior Warehouse Operator at Samsung SDS! You will earn a great starting wage of €15,- per hour. Read on and apply today!

What we offer
- An hourly wage of €15,-!
- Steady hours in dayshift!
- A great employer in Breda!
- Weekly payout of your salary
- Free training to obtain MHE certificates!
- Growth opportunities toward coordinator!

Who you are
To get started as a warehouse operator, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You speak and write English fluently.
- You have at least 1 year of work experience in logistics.
- You are computer literate and skilled with system administration.
- You are available full-time to work in shifts
- You hold a valid MHE certificate or are willing to obtain one
- You are physically able to handle heavy items
- You can work at the job location in Breda

What will you do
As a warehouse operator at Samsung SDS, no two days are the same! You are much more than an average warehouse worker. One moment you ride MHE equipment to shift inventory, and the next you operate the system to inspect and process RMA returns.

- You accurately inspect and register returned goods (RMA) into the computer system.
- You drive MHE equipment safely to transport items through the warehouse.

Where will you work
You will join an energetic, high-performing logistics team at Samsung SDS. Here, you work closely with supervisors and coordinators to hit key targets.

- Work at a world-renowned global logistics leader.
- Perfect mix of physical warehouse tasks and system management.
- Strong team spirit with short communication lines.
